svg.title: Keldyx System Defence Boat - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 46-47, PDF 47-48. Full single-deck hull retains broad flat chamfered forward gun-bay nose, long rectangular central body and two stepped narrower aft sections. Illustration corroborates armoured faceted slab hull. Fusion bay openings do not create a through-hull gap in top projection; detached turrets and internal automated rooms excluded.
